name: the home screen with the "Write or edit" suggestion panel open

regions_read.verdict_on_region: unconventional (bottom band) — names the writing tool the user has opened, i.e. a mode of the app they are in; counted

identifier_found: "Write or edit" heading of the suggestion panel above the composer, with an X, and the composer hint "Write anything"
initial_rationale: the panel heading names the tool the user is in; the top bar remains the unnamed home chrome

test_cases.action: tap "Write or edit" and read the panel heading with the keyboard open and closed
test_cases.expected_result: the heading either names the part of the app the user is in, or names one piece of content
test_cases.confirms_if: it names a piece of content
test_cases.overturns_if: it names the tool/mode the user is in
test_cases.observed_result: the panel opened with the heading "Write or edit", an X, and three pencil suggestions; the composer changed to "Write anything"; the heading stayed visible with the keyboard up. It names the writing tool the user entered, not a piece of content

deciding_evidence: "Write or edit" is the name of the tool the user is working in and stays on screen; accepted as an identifier despite its bottom position. The top bar itself still names nothing (see s1).
recommendation: consider repeating the tool name in the top bar, where people look first
